Then the code owners validation step fails and names the owner not found

  Scenario: AC8 A squad member who is not a code owner cannot satisfy the review (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a pull request that changes "ace-service/src/main/java/<ACE base path>/recovery/casewf/internal/AllocationService.java"
    When a squad member who is not a code owner approves it
    Then the merge is refused with the message "Repository host: review required from code owners"

  Scenario: AC9 A change to the code owners file needs both teams (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a pull request that changes the code owners file
    When a TechX tech lead approves
    Then the merge stays blocked until a member of "@scb-ace/ace-team" also approves

  Scenario: AC10 The last matching pattern decides the owner (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the code owners file has a general pattern for the recovery folders and a later, specific pattern for "ace-service/src/main/java/<ACE base path>/recovery/casewf/internal/AllocationService.java"
    When a pull request changes that file
    Then the owner named by the specific pattern is required as reviewer
